name: arcsonare-bridge
description: Lets ArcSonare read this workspace's editor state and run its configured tasks. Local only — nothing leaves this machine through this extension.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The bridge can run this workspace's configured tasks, which requires a trusted workspace.

commands.title: ArcSonare: Stop the bridge for this window

arcsonare.bridge.shareSelectedText.description: Include the current selection in the context ArcSonare reads. Off by default — a selection is source code.

arcsonare.bridge.shareTerminalOutput.description: Include recent task and debug output. Off by default — build output can contain paths, tokens and machine names.
